build_model_pretrained: build a pretrained ResNet-50 model from the pycls model zoo with downloaded weights
get_model_list: get a list of all available pretrained model names in the pycls model zoo
get_config_file: get the config file path for a specific model by downloading it from the model zoo
get_weights_file: get the weights file path for a specific model by downloading it from the model zoo
get_model_info: get debugging info including config URL, weight URL, and model ID for a model
